faq.q1: How soon will I receive my card after ordering?
faq.a1: After successful payment the system delivers automatically, usually within a few seconds you can view and copy the card in the order. During peak hours there may be slight delays, please refresh the order page.
faq.q2: What if I can't find my order?
faq.a2: Please make sure the order number or contact you entered matches exactly what you used at checkout. Using email or phone returns all historical orders under that contact.
faq.q3: Paid but can't see the card?
faq.a3: Click "View cards" on the order card to expand and copy. If the order shows paid but still has no card content, it may be restocking, please contact online customer service.
faq.q4: What do the order statuses mean?
faq.a4: Pending: order created but unpaid; Paid: payment successful, card auto-delivered; Closed: payment timed out, the system cancelled and released stock.
faq.q5: What if the purchased card doesn't work?
faq.a5: First verify the card was copied completely (mind leading/trailing spaces). If confirmed invalid, keep the order number and a screenshot of the card, and contact customer service immediately for a reissue or refund after verification.
faq.a6: Virtual goods are reproducible, so once the card is viewed, no-reason refunds are generally not supported. If there is a quality issue with the card itself, please contact customer service for verification.
